resolution_rule: Direct owner-qualified FunctionContracts take precedence. Otherwise exactly one generation rule must match the implementation path and visibility. Generated contracts inherit the template and bind the exact owner-qualified callable, AST signature/return annotation and implementation SHA-256 in CI.

PROTOTYPE_INTERNAL_HELPER.authority_requirement: Internal helper cannot create authority beyond its owning prototype module.
PROTOTYPE_INTERNAL_HELPER.result_algebra: Derived from annotated result; no truth/authority promotion implied.
PROTOTYPE_INTERNAL_HELPER.bool_restriction: Bool is permitted only when CI classifies the callable as a total deterministic predicate; otherwise an explicit typed result is required.
PROTOTYPE_INTERNAL_HELPER.resource_and_termination_bounds: Bounded by finite supplied inputs; no background authority.

PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_HTTP.authority_requirement: Read-only public discovery. No GitHub write, deployment, canonical promotion or real-world actuation authority.
PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_HTTP.result_algebra: Typed HTTP/API result with explicit non-success status; no non-PASS state may be relabeled PASS.
PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_HTTP.bool_restriction: No Bool success laundering for multi-terminal operations.
PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_HTTP.resource_and_termination_bounds: Finite local file read/serialization per request.

PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_MCP.authority_requirement: Must remain within AGENT-ENVELOPE-GARDEN-PUBLIC-MCP-v1; no delegation or external action authority.
PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_MCP.result_algebra: Typed MCP/tool result or explicit error.
PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_MCP.bool_restriction: No Bool success laundering for multi-terminal operations.
PUBLIC_DISCOVERY_MCP.resource_and_termination_bounds: Finite local file read/serialization; transport managed by MCP SDK.

SWARM_ORCHESTRATION.authority_requirement: Model outputs are CANDIDATES/PROPOSALS_ONLY and cannot admit, merge, promote canon or gain external action authority.
SWARM_ORCHESTRATION.result_algebra: GardenSwarmRunReceipt/CandidateSynthesis with explicit failure and proposal-only status.
SWARM_ORCHESTRATION.bool_restriction: No Bool collapse of provider/review/admission states.
SWARM_ORCHESTRATION.resource_and_termination_bounds: Bounded by max calls, concurrency, chars, tokens and provider timeout parameters.

MODEL_REVIEW_TOOL.authority_requirement: Free/public reviewer has proposal-only authority and receives no private source, merge, deployment or canonical-promotion authority.
MODEL_REVIEW_TOOL.result_algebra: Structured GardenAgentHandoff/review/availability receipt; failure remains visible.
MODEL_REVIEW_TOOL.bool_restriction: No Bool collapse of provider/review states.

REPO_CONFORMANCE_TOOL.authority_requirement: Verifier/audit tool cannot grant canonical, merge, deployment or external action authority.
REPO_CONFORMANCE_TOOL.result_algebra: Typed verifier/conformance receipt with fail-closed process exit status.
REPO_CONFORMANCE_TOOL.bool_restriction: No Bool-only output where failure class matters.
REPO_CONFORMANCE_TOOL.resource_and_termination_bounds: Finite traversal over tracked repository files/declared records.
